feed.title: WinNewsReader News
feed.subtitle: What's new in WinNewsReader, a feed reader for Windows in the spirit of NetNewsWire.

entry.title: WinNewsReader 1.0.3
entry.summary:
This update fixes checking for updates and makes installation progress visible.

  • Website updates preserve the release feed and packages, preventing 404 errors when checking for updates.
  • Update check and installation failures appear in both the Activity Log and Error Log, including automatic checks at startup.
  • Install and Restart shows download progress and a preparation message before restarting.

entry.title: WinNewsReader 1.0.2
entry.summary:
This update improves reading and strengthens security.

  • Reader View retries failed downloads in a hidden browser, shows loading progress, and reports failures in the article pane and Error Log.
  • The article pane fades in as pages load, and the full app icon is clearer at small sizes.
  • Security fixes escape article header metadata, restrict Feedbin pagination links before sending credentials, and limit single-instance communication to the current Windows user.
  • Release workflows validate version tags and use a pinned packaging tool.

entry.title: WinNewsReader 1.0.1
entry.summary: The installer and the app are now signed with a Certum code-signing certificate, so Windows shows the publisher when you install. A new copy of an app can still get a SmartScreen warning until enough people have installed it.

entry.title: WinNewsReader 1.0.0
entry.summary:
The first release: a native Windows port of NetNewsWire.

  • Reads RSS, Atom, JSON Feed and RSS-in-JSON, with NetNewsWire's article themes.
  • Syncs with FreshRSS, Feedbin, NewsBlur, The Old Reader and BazQux (File → Add Account…), or keeps your feeds on your PC.
  • Reading: Find in Article (Ctrl+F), undo for marking read or starred and deleting a feed or folder, a taskbar unread badge, and feed site icons.
  • Layout: a mail-style column layout with the table across the top, sorting by feed, title, unread and starred, Group by Feed, and a search scope button.
  • Status bar: a selection menu, a theme menu and click-to-cycle counts.
  • Windows: Current Activity, Activity Log, Error Log, Account Stats and Dinosaurs (Ctrl+6 to Ctrl+9).
  • Subscribe by dragging links onto the sidebar.

The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen warns when you install.
